subject: Risk & Compliance
title: AI in AML Detection
description: A quick, practical guide to AI in AML Detection.

hook.text: A human analyst reviews 50 alerts per day. An AI system processes 50,000 and learns which ones matter.

buildup.text: AI models detect complex laundering patterns that rule-based systems miss, like network-level behaviors.

discovery.text: Machine learning reduces false positives by 60-80% in banks that have deployed it successfully.

twist.text: Regulators are skeptical of AI decisions they can't explain. 'The model said so' isn't a valid SAR reason.

climax.text: AI transforms AML from a box-checking exercise into genuine risk detection. But trust must be earned.

punchline.text: AI catches what humans miss. Regulators want to know how.

quiz.question: How much can AI reduce false positives in AML?
